rows.welcome_message_text:
It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to the International Conference on Scientific Advances in Natural and Technological Sciences (SAINTS 2027). The conference reflects CHRIST University's commitment to excellence in teaching, research, innovation, and societal impact.

In an era where global challenges demand interdisciplinary solutions, SAINTS 2027 provides a unique platform for scientists, academicians, industry leaders, policymakers, and students to exchange ideas and foster meaningful collaborations. The conference aims to promote cutting-edge research and technological innovations that contribute to sustainable development and societal well-being.

I am confident that SAINTS 2027 will inspire fruitful discussions, stimulate new research directions, and strengthen international partnerships. I extend my best wishes to all participants for a productive and enriching conference experience.

On behalf of the organizing committee, I am delighted to welcome you to SAINTS 2027 – the International Conference on Scientific Advances in Natural and Technological Sciences.

The conference brings together distinguished researchers, scientists, industry experts, and students from around the world to discuss emerging trends and breakthroughs in science, engineering, technology, and sustainability. Through keynote lectures, technical sessions, panel discussions, and networking opportunities, SAINTS 2027 aims to foster interdisciplinary collaboration and translate scientific discoveries into impactful solutions.

We believe that the exchange of knowledge and ideas during this conference will contribute significantly to addressing global challenges in energy, water, health, environment, advanced materials, and artificial intelligence.

We look forward to welcoming you to CHRIST University and wish you an engaging and rewarding conference.

rows.faq_answer: The International Conference on Scientific Advances in Natural and Technological Sciences, themed *Discovery to Scalable Solutions*. It is hosted by the School of Sciences at CHRIST (Deemed to be University), Bangalore, across four thematic tracks.

rows.faq_question: When and where is it held?
rows.faq_answer: **6 to 8 January 2027** at **CHRIST (Deemed to be University), Bangalore, India**. On-site registration and the inauguration are on 6 January.
Researchers, academicians, industry professionals, innovators and students. Original, unpublished work aligned with any of the four tracks can be submitted.

rows.faq_question: How do I submit an abstract?
rows.faq_answer: Use the official abstract template (Word format, one page, in English) and submit it through the online form on the **Submit Abstract** page by **25 November 2026**. Cover background and objectives, methodology, key results and conclusions. Acceptance is notified on **30 November 2026**.

You can state a preference (oral, poster or either) when submitting. The Scientific Committee makes the final decision after peer review. Oral talks are **10 minutes** plus **5 minutes** of Q&A, in English. Poster guidelines are shared after acceptance.
Yes, in the **SAINTS 2027 Book of Abstracts**, which has an ISBN. Selected papers may be invited for proceedings, edited books or partner-journal special issues, subject to peer review.

rows.faq_question: How do I register, and what does it cost?
rows.faq_answer: Open the registration form from the **Registration & fees** section, pay the fee for your category and upload the receipt. **Early bird** rates apply until **20 November 2026**; registration closes on **31 December 2026**. An accompanying-person category is available.
Yes: Best Oral Presentation, Best Poster Presentation, Best Thesis Pitch and Innovation Award.
Accommodation details are not published yet. For help finding a stay near the campus, write to **saints@christuniversity.in**.

rows.faq_question: Do I need a visa to attend?
rows.faq_answer: Delegates travelling from outside India need a valid Indian visa, applied for through the Indian mission in their country. If you need a letter to support your application, write to **saints@christuniversity.in** with your name, affiliation and registration details.

rows.faq_question: Where can I find the programme and speakers?
rows.faq_answer: Speakers are under **Tracks & speakers**. The programme is announced on **20 December 2026** and will appear in the Schedule section.
